items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Some quote from Lester Young, “Just tickety-tick for Lester, don’t be dropping no bombs” or something. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I guess I got a little too adventurous.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, back in the day, yeah I played with her. But what happened with Marian, that was during the time I was playing with Steve Kuhn and we had just done an album with Gary McFarland, a thing called “October Suite.” Ron Carter was the bass player. And I was working with Marian. And I had to take a couple of nights off and I sent in a friend of mine to sub for me, right? A guy named Jimmy Capas. And then on the next gig he was on, so I got axed by Marian. But I think what happened was that I was maybe trying…
What was that thing Lester Young said —
Where she didn’t want to go.
